title: Recursive event loop spinning: do we still need it if showModalDialog no longer exists?
body:
There are texts which assume the existence of event loop spinning during JavaScript execution:

In [spin the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#spin-the-event-loop):

> 4. Empty the [JavaScript execution context stack](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack).

In [perform a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint):

> Note: This might involve invoking scripted callbacks, which eventually calls the [clean up after running script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#clean-up-after-running-script) steps, which call this [perform a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint) algorithm again, which is why we use the [performing a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#performing-a-microtask-checkpoint) flag to avoid reentrancy.

In [queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#queue-a-microtask):

> Note: It is possible for a [microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#microtask) to be moved to a regular [task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#task-queue), if, during its initial execution, it [spins the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#spin-the-event-loop). This is the only case in which the [source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#concept-task-source), [document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#concept-task-document), and [script evaluation environment settings object set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#script-evaluation-environment-settings-object-set) of the microtask are consulted; they are ignored by the [perform a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/b85e9ae2be2e3d8c887392a87bfa1d4d23d137c7/#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint) algorithm.

The first one was added in https://github.com/whatwg/html/commit/c8aad4fb1e654e2b4db649e6660921c390600633:

> Maintain the stack of incumbent scripts across calls to showModalDialog(), but empty it while that call is running, since showModalDialog() can resume out of order (you can call window.close() on a 'parent' modal window). (Untested.)

As [`showModalDialog` no longer exists](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/374), can it be simplified further?

Related? https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4437
